subject: Re: Encryption evidence and rotation proof — Clearline onboarding
messages:
From: Michael Turner <michael.turner@clearline.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, security.ops@clearline.com
Cc: audit@lockstep.com
Date: 2029-10-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Encryption evidence and rotation proof — Clearline onboarding

Hi Jonas,

As part of Clearline's onboarding for production access we need a compact evidence bundle covering key management and transport protections for SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ review. Specifically we are requesting: 

- HSM/KMS attestation (certificate or manufacturer attestation) and a description of HSM usage for key material.
- A sample of the key rotation index/logs for the last 90 days (include timestamps, key versions, rotation trigger).
- Proof that encryption-in-transit uses modern TLS profiles (cipher suites/tls versions) and any MITM protection for internal service-to-service traffic.
- Confirmation of server-side encryption for customer objects (SSE-KMS vs SSE-S3) and the S3 bucket policy snapshot.
- An example key-wrapping/unwrap event (wrapped key ID, wrap algorithm, KMS key id, and the related transaction id) — sample data redacted is fine.

Please include any automation/playbook you use for emergency rotation and the procedures for key revocation. We aim to complete our questionnaire by Oct 14; can you confirm whether you can deliver the artifacts by then or propose a meeting to align?

Thanks,
Michael Turner
CISO, Clearline Financial

---
Note: audit@lockstep.com is copied for timeline planning and may request additional samples for CAIQ mapping.

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Michael Turner <michael.turner@clearline.com>, security.ops@clearline.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-08T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence and rotation proof — Clearline onboarding

Michael — thanks for the clear list. We can provide an evidence packet that addresses each item. High level plan and ETA: 

1) HSM attestation: we will attach the manufacturer attestation and our internal usage note (HSM is used for root-wrapping and signing of key material).
2) Rotation index/logs: provide a sampled CSV for the last 90 days (anonymized IDs).
3) In-transit encryption: we will provide TLS config snapshots for edge and internal service mesh, plus the cipher suites in use.
4) SSE and bucket policy: snapshot of current S3 policies and confirmation of SSE-KMS default.
5) Key-wrap event sample: redacted event with wrap/unwrap timestamps and KMS key id.

Attachments we will send in a follow-up thread: redwood_hsm_attestation_2029-09-30.pdf, kms_rotation_index_2029_Q3.csv, transport_encryption_manifest_2029-10-08.txt, s3_bucket_policy_snapshot_2029-10-07.json.

We should be able to get the initial bundle to you by 2029-10-10. If you need the DocuSign attestation earlier, I can get that prioritized. Would you prefer a short call (30 min) on Oct 9 to walk through the artifacts?

— Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: irene_choi@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-09T08:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Encryption evidence and rotation proof — Clearline onboarding

Forwarding the artifacts per Jonas' plan. Attached are the initial files and a short readme.

Attachments included: 
- redwood_hsm_attestation_2029-09-30.pdf (HSM vendor attestation; contains device serial range and FIPS validation summary)
- kms_rotation_index_2029_Q3.csv (sampled index — rows redacted for PII; columns: timestamp, key_alias, key_version, trigger)
- transport_encryption_manifest_2029-10-08.txt (edge & mesh TLS parameters, cipher suites, TLS min/max versions)
- s3_bucket_policy_snapshot_2029-10-07.json (policy with SSE-KMS requirement)
- rotation_log_sample_tx-7f3a9c.csv (redacted wrap/unwrap event sample)

A short excerpt from rotation_log_sample_tx-7f3a9c.csv (redacted):
"timestamp, event, key_id, wrapped_key_id, transaction_id"
"2029-09-12T14:22:03Z, WRAP, alias/redwood-root-v3, wk-7f3a9c, tx-7f3a9c"
"2029-09-12T14:22:05Z, UNWRAP, alias/redwood-root-v3, wk-7f3a9c, tx-7f3a9c"

Notes: the rotation index is generated by our key-ops pipeline (kops) and includes automated rotation triggers (age-based) and emergency/manual rotations. We maintain an immutable logging stream; sample shown above is a truncated export for the requested timeframe.

If you need a machine-readable export with full hashes (HMAC masked in export) we can produce one under NDA.

— Irene Choi
Sr. Security Engineer, Key Operations
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Oct 8, 2029 at 11:03 AM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:

From: Auditor Team <audit@lockstep.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-10T16:04:00Z
Subject: RE: Encryption evidence and rotation proof — Clearline onboarding

Jonas/Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. We reviewed the sample and have two follow-ups before mapping CAIQ control fields: 

1) We need a signed attestation from an authorized Redwood officer confirming that the supplied rotation index and the HSM attestation reflect production settings for the Clearline tenancy. Please sign via the DocuSign link below — that will satisfy the SOC 2 evidence requirement for attestation.

2) For one sampled wrap/unwrap event (tx-7f3a9c) please include the KMS key fingerprint (SHA-256) as recorded in your immutable logs and an indication of which HSM hardware slot was used (vendor slot ID or equivalent). Redact any customer-identifying fields.

DocuSign attestation: https://na.docusign.net/clearline-attestation/abcdef123456

If you can deliver the attestation and the fingerprint by 2029-10-12 we can proceed to CAIQ mapping and finalize the onboarding checklist.

Regards,
Lockstep Audit Team
audit@lockstep.com

P.S. Laura — if you are coordinating legal for the attestation, please confirm the signer and scope so the DocuSign envelope can be routed appropriately.
